hero.title: The road ahead
hero.description: Explore the MESBG List Builder journey: what you can already use, what is being improved, and what we hope to build next.

disclaimer: Plans are indicative, not release commitments. Progress counts delivered capabilities; ongoing work is not counted as complete.

releases.disclaimer: This position is illustrative, not a release date or required development order.

v2-public.title: Version 2.0 public release
v2-public.description: An estimated point for a stable public release with the core features of the previous List Builder restored. Integrations and other additions may arrive earlier.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Quick access to rules, profiles and army lists.

rules.title: Game rules
rules.description: Browse all special rules and magical powers

deliverables.details: Read full rules with source references
deliverables.navigate: Follow linked rules and navigate between drawers

deliverables.source: Locate the profile in the books

armies.title: Army lists
armies.description: Understand which armies can field your models.

deliverables.browse: Browse army lists and their rules
deliverables.details: View composition, profile options and rules
deliverables.create: Create rosters directly from army lists
deliverables.special: Display army-wide options and special upgrades correctly

lookup.title: Quick Lookup
lookup.description: Find what you need at the table.

deliverables.search: Search rules, profiles and armies globally
deliverables.details: Open search results directly in the relevant reference view

building.title: Army building
building.description: Create, configure and validate an army roster.

deliverables.move: Move rosters and groups using drag and drop
deliverables.summarize: View roster statistics and army information
deliverables.icons: Custom group icons and visual identity
deliverables.sort: Sort rosters by name, army or value
deliverables.duplicate: Duplicate created rosters for small edits

warbands.title: Warband building
warbands.description: Build your army one warband at a time.

deliverables.create: Create a warband with its leader
deliverables.reorder: Move and reorder followers between warbands
deliverables.edge-cases: Handle unusual warband compositions and remaining edge cases

options.title: Equipment and options
options.description: Choose equipment with the right restrictions.

deliverables.equipment: Enforce equipment selection limits and required choices
deliverables.upgrades: Apply upgrade-specific changes to statistics, keywords or equipment
deliverables.army: Support army-wide options and their selection

deliverables.tier-general: Enforce eligible and highest-tier General rules

deliverables.limits: Show bow- and throwing weapon limits
deliverables.min-max: Enforce minimum and maximum profile requirements
deliverables.required: Enforce required and excluded profile combinations
deliverables.special: Enforce ratios and other special composition rules
deliverables.unique: Enforce unique hero and unit restrictions

share.title: Sharing & Export
share.description: Take your completed roster to the tabletop, share it with other players or use it in another application.

deliverables.image: Share as a visually formatted roster image for Reddit, Discord and Facebook
deliverables.pdf: Export to a clean, printable pdf-document
deliverables.cards: Download selected profiles as quick reference cards
deliverables.link: Share your roster as a read-only link
deliverables.tts: Export roster data for use in Tabletop Simulator
deliverables.text: Copy your rosters as compact readable text for forums and messaging

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Track miniatures you own and what you still need.

inventory.title: Model inventory
inventory.description: Catalogue your models and their equipment.

deliverables.wishlist: Create a wishlist of models your still want to get

coverage.title: Roster coverage
coverage.description: See whether your collection supports a roster.

deliverables.plan: Discover which armies you can build with your existing collection

games.title: Games
games.description: Take your armies to the tabletop, track battles as they unfold, connect with opponents and build a history of your games.

sessions.title: Game sessions
sessions.description: Start, manage and resume games using your existing army rosters.

deliverables.start: Start a new game from an existing roster
deliverables.scenarios: Select a scenario and display objectives
deliverables.finish: Complete or abandon a game session

tracking.title: Live game tracking
tracking.description: Keep track of your army's resources, casualties and battlefield status throughout the game.

deliverables.casualties: Track wounds and casualties for individual models
deliverables.expendables: Track Might, Will, Fate and other expendable resources
deliverables.references: Access profiles and rules directly from the game tracker

scenarios.title: Turns and scenarios
scenarios.description: Follow the flow of a battle with turn tracking, scenario objectives and victory point calculations.

deliverables.phases: Track completed turns and the current game phase
deliverables.objectives: Follow scenario rules and track objectives
deliverables.scoring: Calculate victory points based on scenario conditions

connected.title: Connected games
connected.description: Play together with an opponent using shared, real-time game tracking across multiple devices.

deliverables.invites: Invite an opponent to join a game
deliverables.synchronize: Synchronize game state and trackers in real time
deliverables.reconnect: Reconnect to shared games without losing progress
deliverables.resolve: Handle conflicting changes and keep game state consistent

results.title: Match results and history
results.description: Preserve your completed battles, review previous games and remember the moments that mattered.

deliverables.outcomes: Save final scores, match outcomes and played rosters
deliverables.inspect: Browse match history and review completed games
deliverables.notes: Add notes and memorable moments to your matches

statistics.title: Player statistics
statistics.description: Discover patterns in your games and learn how your armies perform across different opponents and scenarios.

deliverables.trends: Review win rates and performance over time
deliverables.army-performance: Compare results across armies and army lists
deliverables.scenarios: Explore performance across scenarios and points levels

discovery.title: Player and community discovery
discovery.description: Connect with other MESBG players, discover local communities and find your next opponent.

deliverables.local-groups: Find local gaming clubs and communities
deliverables.looking-for-game: Find or advertise opportunities to play a game

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect your MESBG tools and securely use your rosters beyond the List Builder.

access.title: Integration access
access.description: Choose which tools can access your rosters and stay in control of your account.

deliverables.create: Create a separate access key for each integration
deliverables.permissions: Choose what each integration is allowed to read
deliverables.revoke: Revoke an integration's access at any time
deliverables.activity: See when an integration last used its key

rosters.title: Use your rosters elsewhere
rosters.description: Use saved army lists in compatible tools without entering everything again.

deliverables.list: Allow connected tools to find your saved rosters
deliverables.details: Provide complete rosters, including warbands and selected equipment

directory.title: Community integrations
directory.description: Explore tools that work with the List Builder and learn how to connect them.

deliverables.setup: Follow simple instructions to connect each tool

companies.title: Battle Companies
companies.description: Create and grow a persistent Battle Company across games, with individual warriors, live battle tracking and guided War's Aftermath.

management.title: Company management
management.description: Start from a supported ruleset or template, or recreate a company that is already in progress.

deliverables.templates: Create a company from book or community templates
deliverables.rulesets: Choose which published or community ruleset the company follows
deliverables.recreate: Manually recreate a company from paper or another tool
deliverables.members: Recruit, edit and organize individual company members
deliverables.influence: Manage Influence and track company rating

cards.title: Individual character cards
cards.description: Keep every member fully visible, with compact blocks adapting to the information available.

deliverables.details: Display name, portrait, base profile, rank, hero path, points and level
deliverables.stats: Show current characteristics alongside changes to the original profile
deliverables.sections: Show clickable wargear and special rules, plus heroic actions and magical powers when applicable
deliverables.injuries: Track participation status separately from suggested or custom injury descriptions
deliverables.sort: Sort company members by rank, level or name

progression.title: Character progression
progression.description: Develop warriors with guided ruleset-based advancements and optional manual adjustments.

deliverables.experience: Track experience, levels and eligibility for advancement
deliverables.paths: Manage promotions, hero paths, characteristics and new abilities
deliverables.rolls: Use digital dice or enter physical rolls for advancement tables
deliverables.overrides: Review and override outcomes while preserving character development

battles.title: Company battles
battles.description: Play from the company detail screen using the same member cards in Battle mode.

deliverables.start: Start and resume a battle using a snapshot of the company
deliverables.resources: Track remaining Might, Will and Fate for eligible heroes
deliverables.wounds: Track remaining wounds, wounds inflicted and casualties for each member
deliverables.complete: Complete a battle and move into War's Aftermath

aftermath.title: War's Aftermath
aftermath.description: Follow a guided, resumable stepper and commit the resulting company changes together.

deliverables.stepper: Resolve the ruleset-specific aftermath one section at a time
deliverables.injury-rolls: Review casualties and resolve injuries using digital or physical dice
deliverables.experience: Award experience and apply advancements to individual members
deliverables.rewards: Resolve Influence, rewards and other campaign resources
deliverables.recruitment: Recruit warriors and update equipment during aftermath
deliverables.drafts: Save each aftermath step separately and resume unfinished work
deliverables.commit: Review and commit all changes to the company in one operation

history.title: History and graveyard
history.description: Keep a concise record of battles and preserve members who have left the company.

deliverables.battles: Record dates, scenarios, opponents, outcomes and both companies' starting ratings
deliverables.changes: Show company rating and Influence before and after each aftermath
deliverables.graveyard: Keep fallen and retired members with their final profiles and history in the Graveyard

shared.title: Shared campaigns
shared.description: Optionally bring independent companies together in a campaign group.

deliverables.groups: Create and join shared campaign groups
deliverables.companies: Register companies and see other players' progress
deliverables.battles: Link battles between companies participating in a campaign

maps.title: Map-based campaigns
maps.description: A longer-term extension for territorial campaigns.

deliverables.territories: Manage campaign maps and territory control
deliverables.rewards: Apply territorial rewards to participating companies

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.description: Tournament functionality is planned for the future, but its scope is not yet defined and is not a current development focus.

scopePendingDescription: We plan to explore this area later. Specific milestones and deliverables have not been defined yet.
